You might be asking why there are two results for this board. Thats because depending on what dip switch you enable (1 or 2) you get different results. The first readings were with Dip Switch 2 enabled. Which in talking to the board creator would be what to expect with the non saturn version.

As mentioned above, this is the same Saturn Analog I/O board but with Dip Switch 1 On. Here you can get perfect analog output over component video! So if you get this board make sure to turn on only Dip Switch 1 for both RGB and Component output.
